rule: This file defines the permanent order of the Frame. Add depth without moving existing levels.

levels.name: The Separation
levels.description: The distinctions through which relationship becomes visible.

levels.name: The Ladder
levels.description: The structure connecting what has been separated.

levels.name: The Door
levels.description: The threshold where structure becomes experience.

levels.name: The Son
levels.description: The person-bearing transformation at the centre of the story.

levels.name: The Tree of Life
levels.description: The living architecture of continuity, differentiation, manifestation and renewal.

levels.name: The Tree of Strife
levels.description: The failure-pattern in which living relationship fragments into fear, extraction and conflict.

levels.name: The Potato
levels.description: The earthly, embodied, humorous and material expression of the architecture.

levels.name: The World
levels.description: The architecture becomes actual things, systems and relationships.

levels.name: The North Programme
levels.description: The applied field: understand, connect and repair the living system.
